- ISM: 40 more devices decoded, for France, Europe and North America
  - Chacon DIO / KlikAanKlikUit / Home Easy / Nexa, Somfy RTS shutters and gates (new 433.42 MHz band), Blyss and Silvercrest remotes, Visonic PowerCode alarms, X10
  - Weather stations and sensors: Fine Offset / Ecowitt (WH41, WH43, WH45, WH46, WH55, WN34, WS80, WS90), inFactory, Esperanza, Conrad, Alecto V1, WS2032, EMOS E6016, Cotech 36-7959, LaCrosse WS7000 / TX31U / TX34 / BreezePro, Acurite 01185M
  - Thermometers and pool sensors: Inkbird ITH-20R, ThermoPro TX-7B and TP28b, TFA, Rubicson, Bresser leak and lightning sensors
  - Meters: Itron ERT SCM+ and IDM (915 MHz)
  - TP-Link Tapo sensors are recognised on 868.3 MHz by their radio signature
- Censorship test (new, Wi-Fi and mobile data): checks from the phone whether websites, messaging apps, Tor, its bridges, encrypted DNS and VPNs are blocked
  - The result says where: DNS (no answer or a false address), IP, the name in the TLS handshake (SNI filtering), or an interception with an untrusted certificate
  - About 80 websites in 12 categories, your own sites, and the official OONI list of your country
  - Messaging apps: WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Discord; circumvention: Tor, obfs4, Snowflake, meek, DNS over HTTPS and TLS, several VPN providers; transparent proxy detection
  - Results stay on the phone and export as CSV
- The floating dock no longer shows a shortcut to each radio's main tool: it stays the first card of the tools list
